title: grim-consistency-v1 task input
description: A table of reported summary statistics. Each entry is either a MEAN (of N integer responses on a bounded single-item scale, granularity 1/N) or a PERCENTAGE (k of N respondents, granularity 100/N). The player must judge, per statistic, whether the reported value is mathematically impossible at the stated sample size (GRIM inconsistency). SD is descriptive context only; this arena is GRIM-only and never asks about SD.

statistics.description: The reported summary statistics. One entry per reported mean or percentage.

stat_type.description: Which granularity test applies. 'mean': the value sits on a 1/N grid (mean/sd/n_items/scale_min/scale_max present). 'percent': the value is a percentage of a count and sits on a 100/N grid (percent present).

mean.description: Reported mean, as printed. Present when stat_type='mean'.

sd.description: Reported sample standard deviation, as printed. Present when stat_type='mean'. Descriptive context only — never an injected issue.

percent.description: Reported percentage of respondents, as printed. Present when stat_type='percent'.

n.description: Number of respondents the statistic is computed over.

n_items.description: Number of integer items summed into one respondent's score. Always 1 in this GRIM-only arena (single-item scores; mean granularity 1/N). Present when stat_type='mean'.

scale_min.description: Minimum value of a single item. Present when stat_type='mean'.

scale_max.description: Maximum value of a single item. Present when stat_type='mean'.

decimals.description: Number of decimals the value is reported to (means: 2; percentages: 1).
